# Driftwood Recovery

> > A residential addiction and pain treatment center in Austin, Texas offering evidence-based and holistic recovery programs for substance use disorder and co-occurring mental health conditions.

Driftwood Recovery is a luxury rehabilitation facility specializing in personalized treatment for addiction, opioid use disorder, chronic pain, and dual diagnosis. The center provides multiple levels of care from medical detoxification through long-term alumni support, guided by a clinical team including Medical Director Dr. Rey Ximenes and leadership under President Peter Fluor.

## Key Topics

- Substance Use Disorder (SUD)
- Residential Treatment
- Medical Detoxification
- Opioid Rehab
- Dual Diagnosis
- Co-occurring Disorders
- Holistic Treatment Approach
- EMDR Therapy
- Pain Management
- Community Integration
- Family Therapy
- Alumni Support
- The Joint Commission
- Evidence-Based Recovery
- Addiction Treatment

## Treatment Programs

- [Programs - Austin Substance Abuse Treatment Center](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs): Overview of treatment programs and levels of care at Driftwood Recovery.
- [Stabilization & Assessment - Medical Detox - Executive Recovery Center](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs/stabilization-assessment): Medical detoxification and assessment program with psychological testing at Driftwood.
- [Residential Treatment | Luxury Driftwood Recovery Center Texas](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs/residential-treatment): Residential treatment program offering holistic therapy for addiction and dual diagnosis.
- [Community Integration Program at Driftwood Recovery](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs/community-integration): Community integration and outpatient aftercare program for ongoing recovery support.
- [Driftwood Recovery Alumni Program: Building Lasting Connections and Support](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs/alumni-program): Alumni program providing peer support and continuing care for long-term recovery.
- [Courageous Family Program | Driftwood Recovery Center Texas](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/programs/courageous-family-program): Family therapy and support program for loved ones involved in addiction recovery.

## Conditions & Specialties

- [Conditions - Chronic Pain and Mental Health Treatment in Texas](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/conditions): Overview of conditions treated including chronic pain, mental health, and substance abuse.
- [Comprehensive Opioid Rehab at Driftwood Recovery: Holistic Care for Lasting Recovery](https://driftwoodrecovery.com/conditions/opioid-rehab): Specialized opioid use disorder treatment program using evidence-based and holistic therapies.
